subject: maths
question: Ramesh and Naresh start running on a circular track of length 1920 metres from the same point simultaneously in the same direction with speed of 40 m/sec and 64 m/sec. After how much time from the start will they meet for the first time anywhere on the track?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of track = 1920 m,

Speed of Ramesh = 40 m/sec,

Speed of Naresh = 64 m/sec

**Concept:**

Time to meet = Length of track/Relative speed

**Solution:**

⇒ Time to meet = 1920 m/(64 m/sec - 40 m/sec)

⇒ Time to meet = 80 sec

**Therefore, they will meet for the first time 80 seconds after they start.**
